step_by_step_reasoning: The visual diagram shows database client applications (EC2 and Lambda) connecting through a Network Load Balancer (NLB) to an Auto Scaling layer of Heimdall proxies running on EC2. The proxies query an ElastiCache layer for fast retrieval, fall back to RDS for missing data, and connect to a central Management server for configuration.
